# AgentRules.dev
> Curated, production-grade AI coding rulesets and autonomous agent protocols for Cursor (.cursorrules), Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), and Antigravity (AGENTS.md).

## What is AgentRules.dev?
AgentRules.dev is an open developer marketplace providing battle-tested system prompt rulesets, code hygiene guidelines, and autonomous workflows. It helps developers stop fixing AI hallucinations and reduce code review time by up to 80%.

## Available Rulesets
- Next.js 15 & Tailwind Fullstack Architect (`01-fullstack-nextjs-tailwind.cursorrules`): Enterprise App Router, Server Actions, TypeScript strict.
- FastAPI Python Clean Architecture (`02-fastapi-python-clean-architecture.cursorrules`): Python 3.12+, Pydantic v2 strict, SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async, Ruff.
- Autonomous Agent ODD Protocol (`03-autonomous-agent-odd-protocol.md`): Metaprompt 5-part PRD spec, Red-Green TDD, zero-hallucination execution.
- Docker & Cloud DevOps Gatekeeper (`04-docker-cloud-devops-gatekeeper.md`): Minimal container builds (<50MB), CI/CD GitHub Actions, zero-downtime releases.
- Solopreneur Micro-SaaS 48H Launchpad (`05-solopreneur-saas-launchpad.md`): High-velocity 48h launch stack with PayPal USD checkout.
- AI SEO, GEO & Perplexity Ranker (`06-ai-seo-llmo-perplexity-ranker.md`): High SNR formatting, Schema JSON-LD, llms.txt compliance.
- iOS & macOS Native SwiftUI Master (`07-ios-swift-swiftui-native.cursorrules`): Swift 6 Concurrency, MVVM-C, Apple HIG, StoreKit 2.
- PostgreSQL & Supabase Security Guard (`08-database-postgres-supabase-guard.md`): Zero-downtime migrations, Row Level Security (RLS) tenant isolation.
